name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 58

clue.text: The Proms are disastrous without right pervading mood
Common Greek character gone missing
Boastful joker, German, comes in to confess to crime
Knife chopped herb
She’d be put out getting her pages torn
False king strangled by favourite destroyed
Tree left one with resin
Plump canon
Vehicle ploughing into others — showing lack of this?
Pro Man? This is different (having unlimited coldness)
Row elicits a sign of regret, we hear
Angry language puzzles
Dull leader going? One’s hopeful
Jumper to be altered at the front — pure cloth required
See part of building half cave in
Fellow nurses old grievance
Walk in mourning, following the music
What’s the girl wearing, the bird with the long legs?
See danger? It could come from traitors
Ah, pal, I’m hot, out of sorts — it’s a sort of inflammation
With falsehood one local business centre has taken girl in
Leader of company, more competent, taking off, letting in one novice — a means of getting to the top
Priest wandering around the Eternal City: ‘It’s breath- taking!’
Sets apart those who are looking for something in the London area?
Secretive type speaking with difficulty to audience after nightfall
